settings.title: Settings
settings.authConfigured: API credentials configured. Authenticated endpoints accessible.
settings.authNotConfigured: No API credentials configured. Only public browser endpoints accessible.
settings.credentialHint: Credentials persist to browser localStorage (Secret encoded). Used only for HMAC-SHA256 request signing.
settings.apiSecretPlaceholder: Enter merchant API Secret (HMAC signing key)
settings.secretHint: Used for HMAC-SHA256 request signing. Never transmitted in plaintext.
settings.security1: API Secret is held only in browser memory for HMAC-SHA256 signature computation.
settings.security2: localStorage stores Secret XOR + base64 encoded, avoiding plaintext visibility.
settings.security3: Credentials are never sent in request body; only signature header X-NexusChain-Signature is generated.
settings.security4: Clear browser data or click "Clear Credentials" to remove local storage immediately.
settings.security5: Do not save credentials on public devices.
settings.errKeyLength: API Key must be at least 8 characters
settings.errSecretLength: API Secret must be at least 16 characters (HMAC-SHA256 security requirement)
